title: GOD OF JABEZ CHANGE MY STORY THIS MORNING
text: Something is about to happen to somebody's story this morning. And I'm not talking in riddles. Before the microphone found my hand, before the sound of instruments [music] settled, I already sensed a company of people in this place carrying a version of their life they never signed for. You came in wearing the face of management. You have been managing a marriage that should be flourishing, managing a business that should be multiplying, managing a body that should be strong, managing a name that should be spoken with honor. I want to tell you something before we go any further. God did not call you here to help you manage your story. He called you here to change it. Lift your hands where you are. Not because it is a formality, but because faith requires a posture of expectation. Somewhere in this gathering, whether you are sitting in a hall or watching this through a [music] screen with your name written on your palm, heaven has taken note of you. I sense the spirit of the living God brooding over gatherings like this. The way he brooded over the face of the waters in the beginning, before there was a beginning, before there was a form to anything, he is still that same spirit. He still knows how to move over chaos [music] and speak a world into being. And this morning, he's brooding over your chaos. I will not preach you a lecture. I have not come to give you information about Jabz. Information does not deliver anybody. Revelation delivers. There is a difference between knowing a Bible story and encountering the God inside that Bible story. This morning, I want you to encounter him. So before I say another sentence, let the atmosphere shift. Something in the unseen realm is realigning right now. And if you are sensitive in your spirit, you will feel it. A stirring, a warmth, a quiet violence against everything that has held your story hostage. Turn with me in your heart, if not in your hands, to 1 Chronicles 4:9. The Bible says, "Jabz was more honorable than his brothers, and his mother called his name Jabz, saying, [music] because I bore him with sorrow." Now watch this. A name was given to a child [music] based on the pain of the woman who carried him. Nobody asked the child's permission. Nobody consulted heaven about what that boy would become. A moment of sorrow in a delivery room became a life sentence. Spoken over an innocent child. And that child grew up every single day of his life being called sorrow. Every time his father called him for dinner, sorrow. Every time his teacher called his name in front of his mates, sorrow. Every time he introduced himself to a stranger, sorrow, sorrow, sorrow. [music] I want you to understand something about the power of a name, about the power of a word spoken over you before you had the capacity to resist it. Some of you are not fighting a physical battle this morning. You are fighting a name. Somebody called you a mistake and it followed you into your marriage. Somebody called you a failure and it followed you into your business. Somebody said you would never amount to anything and [music] 30, 40 years later you are still negotiating with that sentence like it is scripture. It is not scripture. It was never scripture. And this morning we are going to deal with it like the counterfeit word that it is. But here is what me about this man Jabz. Verse 10 [music] says, "Jabz called on the God of Israel, saying, "Oh, that you would bless me indeed and enlarge my coast and that your hand might be with me [music] and that you would keep me from evil that it may not grieve me." This man refused to let a name determine [music] his destiny. He took the very sorrow that was spoken over him and he turned it into a prayer point. He did not argue with his mother. He did not hold a grudge against his circumstances of birth. [music] He went over the head of every human voice that had labeled him and he [music] took his case directly to the God of Israel. That is what real prayer is. Real prayer is not asking God for information. Real prayer is appealing a verdict that man has already passed on your life. [music] Somebody shout it with me. My story is not over. Say it like you mean it. Because heaven responds to conviction, not to volume. God is not moved by how loud you can shout. He is moved [music] by whether you actually believe what is coming out of your mouth. So I'm not asking you to scream. I am asking you to [music] believe. There is a reason the Bible records that God granted him that which he requested. Not because Jabz used special language. [music] Not because Jabz had access to some secret formula that has been hidden from you. God granted it because Jabz dared [music] to ask outside the boundary of what his name suggested was possible for him. And I am here to prophesy to somebody that the God of Jabz did not retire after that one chapter. He is still in the business of enlarging coasts. He still in the business of overturning names spoken by broken people over innocent destinies. He's still in the business of blessing indeed. Not blessing partially, not blessing symbolically, but blessing indeed. Blessing so thoroughly that the evidence becomes undeniable to everyone who has watched you struggle. I feel led to say this to somebody specifically. There is a woman here and the spirit of God says to tell her, the delay you have experienced was never a rejection. It was a positioning. What the enemy call baroness, God is calling a waiting room. and your waiting room is about to open into a birthing room. I do not know your name. I do not know your face, but heaven knows exactly who you are. And this morning, the God of Jabz is answering you indeed. Let us go deeper because there is a pattern in this prayer that most people skip past too quickly. [music] Jabz did not only ask for blessing. He asked for enlargement of coast meaning territory meaning influence meaning the boundaries of his life to be pushed outward. [music] Then he asked for the hand of God to be with him meaning covering meaning partnership meaning he refused to walk alone into his expansion. And then this is the part that many overlook. He asked to be kept from evil that it may not grieve him. He was not naive about the fact that enlargement attracts attacks. When your [music] cost increases, the traffic of hell around your life increases with it. So he prayed a complete prayer. Bless me, enlarge me, cover me, protect me. That is not a shallow prayer. That is warfare dressed in the language of petition. I want to remind you of Genesis 32:26 where a man called Jacob wrestled through the night with a divine visitor. And as the day began to break, the visitor said, "Let me go for the day breaks." And Jacob, wounded, limping, refused, and said, "I will not let you go except you bless me." That is the same spirit that sat inside Jabz. That is the same spirit I am calling out of you this morning. Somewhere along the way, many [music] of us have learned to let go too quickly. We pray for 2 weeks and if heaven does not answer on our schedule, we release the promise and go back to managing our disappointment, I am here to put steel back into your spine this morning. Some of you need to wrestle. Some of you need to say to God, until my story changes, I am not releasing you. The Bible tells us in Habacook 2:2 to write the vision and make it plain because though it tries, we should wait for it for it will surely come. It [music] will not tarry. Surely come. Not maybe come. Not come if you behave well enough. Surely come. [music] There is a certainty embedded in that word that the enemy has tried to erase from your vocabulary. He has convinced many of God's own children that their breakthrough is a maybe. It is not a maybe. It is a surely somebody in this place needs to write it down. Whatever it is, the [music] business, the child, the marriage, the healing, the visa, the promotion. Write it down and watch it walk toward you on legs you did not build. I feel a shift happening in the spirit realm. Even as I speak, there is a stubborn wall around certain destinies in this gathering. [music] And the Lord says that wall is not as strong as it has convinced you it is. Isaiah 60:1 says, "Arise, shine, for your light has come and the glory of the Lord has risen upon you." [music] Notice the instruction. Arise, not wait, not hope. Arise. There is a posture change required of you before the manifestation shows up. You cannot lie down in defeat and expect to rise in glory. Something in your spirit has to stand up on the inside before your circumstances catch up on the outside. [music] I decree over somebody's finances this morning that the God who opened the windows of heaven in Malachi 3:10 is opening a window over your account that has been shut for years. I decree that every gate that has been padlocked against your progress is [music] receiving the fire of God as a master key this very hour. Say after me, "Wherever you are, my gates are opening now." There is a woman crying quietly somewhere in this gathering, [music] and I sense the burden of a marriage that looks nothing like the covenant she said yes to. [music] The spirit of God says, "I have not forgotten the vow spoken over your union. And what man has twisted through selfishness and neglect, I am able to restore." Joel 2:25 tells us that God will restore the years that the locust has eaten the cankerworm, the caterpillar and the palmer worm. That verse is not only about crops. It is about seasons of your life that felt eaten alive, stripped bare, robbed of joy. God specializes in giving back what looks unreoverable. He does not give you a substitute. [music] He gives you back the years. I speak to every household represented here this morning. There is a generational pattern that some of you have accepted as simply how your family behaves. The short tempers, the sudden sicknesses, the marriages that never last past a certain year, the sons who wander, the daughters who suffer heartbreak after heartbreak. I want you to know that pattern is not your portion by inheritance. Deuteronomy 28:13 declares that the Lord will make you the head and not the tail, above only and not beneath. [music] If you listen to his commandments, headship is your covenant right. Every family c riding on the back of your bloodline is being confronted in this hour. And I declare by the authority of the word of God that it stops [music] with you. It stops with you. It does not pass to your children. It stops with you. Let the declarations rise. Say it boldly. Every evil altar assigned to interrupt my story is scattered by fire. Every voice that spoke death over my beginning is silenced by a louder voice from heaven. My starting point [music] does not determine my finishing point. What labor and sorrow named [music] me. Grace is renaming me. I am not what they called me. I am what [music] God is calling me. Isaiah 43:1 19 says, "Behold, I will do a new thing. Now it shall spring forth. Shall you not know it? I will even make a way in the wilderness and rivers in the desert, new, not recycled, not a repaired version of your old testimony, a new thing. There are people here who are tired [music] of asking God to fix what is broken. I want you to shift your prayer language this morning. Stop asking him to repair the old wine skin. asking for new wine, [music] new wine skin, new chapter, new location, new level, new company, new health report, new financial identity. I [music] sense the presence of the Lord thickening in this place like a cloud settling low over a valley. Some of you have been praying with your eyes but not with your spirit, [music] going through motions without contact. I want to invite you into something deeper right now. Close your eyes if you are able and let your heart, not your lips, begin to cry out. There is no performance required here. Heaven is not scoring your eloquence. Heaven is scanning your sincerity. Father, in the name that is above every name, we come boldly before your throne this morning. [music] Not because we have earned access, but because the blood of the lamb has already spoken on our behalf. We ask you, oh God of Jabz, bless us indeed. Not partially, not eventually. Indeed, [music] let this morning mark the point where our children and our children's children would [music] trace back and say that was when everything changed. Every destiny in this gathering that has been sitting in a waiting room longer than it should, I command it to move by fire. [music] Ecclesiastes 3:1 says, "There is a time for every purpose under heaven. I decree that your time has [music] come, not somebody else's time borrowed and delayed and rescheduled onto your calendar. Your own appointed time arriving on schedule according to the counsel of God, not according to the interference of hell. I call for the fire of the Holy Ghost to fall [music] on every family altar in this gathering right now. Let every unclean covenant made by ancestors who did not know better be broken over the lives of their descendants who are seeking God today. You did not make that covenant with the river God of your village. You did not make that covenant with the shrine your grandfather visited. But if it still has legal ground over your bloodline, [music] I speak the blood of Jesus against it this hour and I declare it null and void in the courts of heaven. Let every woman believing for the fruit of the womb receive a fresh commissioning from heaven this morning. The same God who visited Hannah, the same God who opened the womb of Sarah in her old age, the same God who caused Elizabeth to carry a foreigner in her later years is not limited by your medical report. [music] Your file in the courts of heaven does not match the file in your doctor's office. And I decree that the heavenly file is the one that stands. Receive grace to conceive. Receive grace to carry to full time. Receive grace to hold your baby and remember this morning as the turning point to the man carrying the weight of a business that refuses to break [music] even. I speak destiny alignment over your labor. Deuteronomy 8:18 reminds us that it is God who gives power to get wealth that he may establish his covenant. Your struggle has not been for lack of effort. Some of you [music] work harder than people who are 10 times more prosperous than you. This is not about effort. This is about alignment. I decree that every misalignment between your labor and your harvest is corrected this morning. What you have sown for years without reaping. You will reap suddenly and it will look like it came all at once because heaven has been storing it. There is a young person here maybe watching this on a phone screen with headphones in wrestling with a sense of purposelessness. feeling like everyone around them has a plan except them. I speak to you directly. Jeremiah 29:11 says, "For I know the thoughts that I think toward you, sayeth the Lord, thoughts [music] of peace and not of evil to give you an expected end. God already has a blueprint for your life. You did not miss it by being confused for a season. [music] Confusion is not disqualification. I release clarity over your mind this morning. I release direction over your next step. You will not wander forever. Somebody said amen like they believe it. I want to pray now over health because I sense in my spirit that there is sickness in this gathering that has resisted every human method of treatment and it [music] is time for a divine encounter. Whatever diagnosis has tried to write the final chapter of somebody's life, I declare by the authority given to the church that it is not the final chapter. Psalm 30:5 tells us that weeping may endure for a night, but joy comes in the morning. If you have been in a long night of pain, I decree this is your morning. Every cell in your body that has been operating outside of divine order is realigning right now in the name of Jesus. Every growth that has no right to exist in a body created in the image of God is commanded to wither at the root. [music] I sense a specific pain in someone's chest area. A tightness that has troubled you for months [music] and you have been afraid to get it checked. The spirit of God says go and get it checked. And by the time you sit in that consultation room, the report will surprise the very people who ordered the test. Faith does not mean avoiding the doctor. Faith means walking into that appointment already carrying the report of heaven. There is a mother here praying for a wandering child, a son or a daughter who has drifted from the values they were raised with, who no longer picks up the phone, who has chosen company that worries you at night. [music] I speak to that wandering heart this morning. The same hound of heaven that pursued the prodigal son is pursuing your child right now in whatever city, whatever room, whatever company they are hiding in. [music] Luke tells us the story of a son who came to himself who woke up in a pig's pen and remembered his father's house. I decree that your child is coming to themselves. Whatever they have wandered into, they will remember home. They will remember the God you introduce them to before the world tried to introduce them to something else. I want to pause here and address something that many believers carry silently. The fear that their own past mistakes have disqualified them from this kind of blessing. Somebody is sitting here thinking this word is for other people not for me because of what I did [music] because of the years I spent far from God because of decisions I made that I'm still paying for. I want to remind you of a man named Manasse. One of the most wicked kings [music] recorded in the book of 2 Chronicles. A man who built altars to [music] false gods inside the very temple of the Lord. Who practiced sorcery. who shed innocent blood in the streets of Jerusalem. And yet when he humbled himself in captivity [music] and cried out to God, the Bible says the Lord was entreated of him and heard his supplication and brought him again to Jerusalem into his kingdom. If [music] God restored Manasse, there is no file on you to damage for him to reopen. Your past is not a disqualification. It is simply the chapter before the turnaround. Let the fire fall on shame this morning. Shame has kept more people out of their breakthrough than sin ever has because shame convinces you that you are no longer eligible to ask. I decree that every voice of shame assigned to keep you silent before God is silenced right now. You are eligible. You have always been eligible. Grace does not run out. >> [music] >> Let us rise into a season of aggressive intercession now because comfortable prayer does not dismantle established strongholds. Exodus 14:14 tells us, "The Lord shall fight for you and you shall hold your peace." Notice that even in stillness, there is warfare happening on your behalf. You do not always have to feel the fight to know that the fight is happening. Some of your battles are being won in realms you cannot see by a God who does not need your permission to defend what belongs to him. I decree war against every [music] evil altar that has been erected against destinies in this place. Whether [music] it was built in a village shrine, in a witch doctor's compound, in a covenant of blood sworn by ancestors who did not understand the weight of what they were binding onto their unborn generations. I speak destruction to that altar in the name that is above every name. [music] Let the fire of God locate every physical and spiritual altar assigned [music] against anyone connected to this ministration and let it be consumed. No negotiation, no mercy for what has stolen mercy from innocent lives. I call forth angelic reinforcement over every person contending in this season. 2 Kings 6:17 tells the story of Elisha's servant terrified at the sight of an approaching army until Elisha prayed, "Lord, open his eyes." And the young man saw that the mountain was full of horses and chariots of fire round about Elisha. There has always been more with you than against you. You have simply not had your eyes open to see it. I pray that prayer over you now. [music] Lord, open their eyes. Let them see the chariots that have surrounded their situation the entire time they thought they were facing it alone. Let every witchcraft assignment programmed against destinies in this gathering be aborted in the name of Jesus. [music] Every dream where you were being chased, every dream where you were eating unfamiliar food served by unfamiliar hands, [music] every dream where you woke up exhausted as though you had been laboring all night, [music] I cancel the legal ground behind those dreams. Isaiah 54:17 declares that no weapon formed against you shall prosper and every tongue that rises against you in judgment you shall condemn. This is your inheritance as a child of God. This verse says your righteousness is of me sayaeth the Lord. Not your performance, not your perfect record. Your righteousness comes from him and that righteousness is your legal defense in the courts of the spirit realm. I speak now to the wasted years. Some of you feel like you started late, that your mates have overtaken you, that the season for certain things has passed you by. I remind you that with the Lord, one day is as a thousand years and a thousand years as one day. [music] Time does not restrict him the way it restricts you. Joel's promise of restoration is not sentimental language. It is a legal declaration that the years devoured by delay, by sickness, [music] by heartbreak, by wrong decisions, by seasons you spent serving, assignments that were never yours to carry. Those years are being restored to you, not symbolically but practically in the form of accelerated favor, [music] compressed timelines, and doors that open faster than natural process would allow. Declare this with me. What took others 10 years to build, I will build in half the time. Because my God compresses [music] seasons for those who honor him. Say it again with fire in your voice. My slow years are over. I sense virtue that has been drained from certain lives in this gathering. Virtue lost through toxic relationships. Virtue lost through years of people pleasing. Virtue lost through carrying burdens that were never assigned to you. There was a woman in the Gospel of Mark who had an issue of blood for 12 years who pressed through a crowd just to touch the hem of a garment and Jesus felt virtue leave him and enter her and she was made whole instantly. I decree a return of virtue to every depleted spirit in this place. Whatever [music] has been drained from you by demanding relationships and tankless assignments, I call it back in the name of Jesus. Your joy return, your strength return, your peace of mind return, your laughter return. Let [music] divine preservation cover every person connected to this word. Psalm 91:1 says, "He that dwells in the secret place of the most high shall abide under the shadow of the almighty." I decree that as [music] your story changes, as your enlargement begins, as doors open that have been sealed for years, you will not become a target for destruction. Increase without preservation is a trap. I cover your travels. I cover your health. I cover your finances. I cover your family. I cover your sleep. I cover your waking under the shadow of the Almighty. From this morning forward, I feel the spirit of God wanting to speak specifically to individuals now. So I ask you to be still and receive whatever is for you and release whatever is not. There is someone here who applied for something recently and has been waiting on a response that has not come. I say to you the delay is not a rejection. Expect contact within days not months. There is a man nursing a private financial embarrassment, ashamed to tell even those closest to him how tight things have become. God says, "I saw the account before you checked it this morning." And I am about to embarrass that shame with a testimony you will not be able to keep quiet. [music] There is someone whose relationship ended in a way that left deep confusion wondering what was wrong [music] with you. Hear this clearly. Nothing was wrong with you. That door closed because a better door was being built and you will recognize it when it opens because it will not carry the same chaos the last one did. There is a father here who has been praying silently for a wayward child for years and has grown almost afraid to hope again. I say to you, do not stop praying now. You are closer to the answer than you have ever been. The turnaround is not far. There is someone dealing with sleeplessness, [music] a mind that races the moment the lights go off, replaying conversations, replaying failures, replaying fears. I decree the peace of God which passes understanding over your nights from today. You will sleep and your sleep will be sweet. There is a business owner here who has been quietly considering shutting everything down, convinced the vision has failed. I say to you, do not close what heaven has not released you to close. There is a contract, a client, a partnership on its way that will change the entire trajectory of what you almost gave up on. There is a young woman comparing her timeline to everyone around her, watching friends marry, friends conceive, friends relocate while she feels stuck. I speak to that comparison spirit and I break its hold over your peace. Your timeline was never meant to look like theirs. What God is building in you during this season of apparent delay will make your eventual breakthrough studier than [music] theirs. There is someone who lost a loved one recently and has been struggling to find God in the grief. I will not offer you a formula for pain like this. I will only remind you that the same God who wept at the tomb of Lazarus though he knew he would raise him does not despise your tears. Grief honestly. He's not offended by your sorrow. He's present in it. There is a minister, a worker, someone serving quietly in a ministry or organization who feels unseen, unappreciated, taken for granted. God sees the sacrifice hidden from human recognition. [music] And I decree that hidden faithfulness is about to be rewarded openly. There is someone battling a besetting sin they have confessed and returned to more times than they can count. Exhausted by their own inconsistency. I speak grace over you this morning. Not permission. Grace. There is no condemnation for those who are in Christ Jesus. Get back up. Grace is not tired of you. There is someone who has been secretly planning to relocate, filling forms, gathering documents, and has hit obstacle after obstacle at the point of approval. I speak to that file sitting on somebody's desk in an office you have never seen. And I command it to move to the top of the pile [music] in the name of Jesus. What has been delayed by paperwork will not be delayed by hell any longer. [music] There is a caregiver here. Someone quietly exhausted from carrying the needs of an aging parent or a sick relative who has not had a moment to breathe in a long time. I see your labor. Heaven has not overlooked one sleepless night. Strength [music] is being renewed in you this morning. And help is coming in a form you did not expect from [music] a person you did not anticipate. There is someone who has been offered an opportunity that looks smaller than what they believe they deserve and [music] pride has been whispering to reject it. I say to you, do not despise the day of [music] small beginnings, for that small door is the one heaven has assigned to lead you into the larger room. Walk through it. Let the declarations [music] intensify now. Because this word must not simply be heard. It [music] must be enforced by your own mouth. Say boldly wherever you are, I refuse to die with my assignment unfulfilled. I refuse to bury potential that heaven invested in me. I refuse to let fear write the final draft of my story. I speak to every dream deferred in this gathering. Genesis 12:2 records God telling Abraham, "I will make of you a great nation, and I [music] will bless you and make your name great, and you shall be a blessing." Abraham was 75 years old [music] with no visible evidence of that promise when it was spoken. I decree that age, [music] delay, and lack of visible evidence do not disqualify you from the promise of God. What he has spoken over your life, [music] he is well able to perform. Regardless of how long the manifestation has taken, there is a final layer of prayer I feel compelled to lead you through and it concerns preservation of everything we have just contended for. Because I have watched too many people receive a genuine breakthrough only to lose it within months to carelessness, to pride, to returning to old patterns that invited the very trouble God delivered them from. So we pray now not only for the change to come but for the change to remain. Father we ask that whatever you release into our lives from this hour forward would [music] be protected by your grace and stewarded by our obedience. Let us not become so consumed by the blessing that we forget the blesser. Let us not repeat the mistakes that open doors for trouble in the first place. Guard our hearts against the arrogance that often follows sudden increase. Keep us dependent on you even in abundance. I decree over the marriages represented here. That love is being rekindled where it has grown cold. That communication is being restored where silence has taken over. That intimacy is returning where distance has settled in. I speak to every spirit of strife assigned to destroy homes. and I command it to leave in the name of Jesus. Husbands, receive fresh grace to leave with patience. [music] Wives, receive fresh grace to trust again. Children, receive an atmosphere of peace in your homes [music] that you have been longing for without knowing how to ask for it. I decree over singles believing for a spouse [music] that confusion is lifting. That discernment is sharpening. That the right person is being positioned to cross your path at the right time. Not forced, not manipulated, but divinely [music] arranged the way Isaac met Rebecca at a well that was never a coincidence. To those who have been wounded by a previous relationship and are afraid to trust again, I speak healing over the fear that has attached itself to your heart. Not every closed door was a punishment. Some closed doors were protection dressed up as disappointment. [music] You were not too much. You were not too difficult. You were simply not meant for that assignment. [music] And the discernment you are gaining now will serve you for the rest of your life. I sense someone here who has quietly [music] given up on believing for reconciliation in an estrange relationship. A sibling who no longer speaks to [music] you. A parent and child divided by years of silence. A friendship that ended in a way that was never resolved. I decree that bridges long thought burned are being rebuilt where it is for your good and God's glory. [music] Where reconciliation is not possible, I decree the grace to release it without bitterness, so that unforgiveness does not become the next generational altar you unknowingly pass down. I decree over every financial gate assigned against destinies in [music] this place, open now. Every contract delayed in an office somewhere, move now. Every [music] payment held up by bureaucracy or by malice, release now. Every business idea sitting dormant because of fear of failure, receive courage [music] now. Every debt that has hovered over a family for years, receive a strategy for cancellation now. I decree over health, complete restoration, no relapse, no return of what has been driven out. Full and total healing. The kind that doctors themselves marvel at. The kind that becomes a testimony passed down for generations. I decree over the young people in this gathering direction, mentorship, discipline, and the wisdom to build their lives on foundations that will not collapse when the storms of life come. Because Matthew reminds us that the wise man builds his house upon the rock. And though the rain descends and the floods come and the winds blow, [music] that house does not fall because it was founded upon the rock. I release a final decree over every single person who has [music] been part of this ministration, whether present physically or connected through a screen. From this morning, your story begins a new chapter, not a continuation of the old one with minor edits, [music] a genuinely new chapter written by the same God who took a boy named Sorrow and turned him into a man whose prayer became scripture. whose name outlived the pain that birthed it. Whose story is still being told thousands of years later. Not because of what his mother called him, but because of what he refused to accept as final. You are not what they called you. You are not what your circumstances named you. You are not what your family history has decided for you. You are what God in [music] his infinite mercy is calling you to become. And this morning marks the beginning of that becoming. Go in the confidence of a man or woman who has been prayed for by heaven itself. Walk differently, speak differently, expect differently. The God of Jabz has heard you. And what he has heard, [music] he is answering. Indeed.
